cases.expected: Rule instance of OverIndicatorRule where rule.isSatisfied(0) == true
cases.description: Create a NumericIndicator wrapping a ConstantIndicator(10) and compare it with another ConstantIndicator(5). The returned Rule should be an OverIndicatorRule and evaluate to true because 10 > 5 at index 0.

cases.expected: Rule instance of OverIndicatorRule where rule.isSatisfied(0) == false
cases.description: Create a NumericIndicator wrapping a ConstantIndicator(10) and compare it with ConstantIndicator(15). The returned Rule should be an OverIndicatorRule and evaluate to false because 10 is not greater than 15 at index 0.

cases.expected: Rule instance of OverIndicatorRule where rule.isSatisfied(0) == true, rule.isSatisfied(1) == false, rule.isSatisfied(2) == true
cases.description: NumericIndicator wraps a ConstantIndicator(10). The supplied other indicator returns 5 at index 0, 15 at index 1 and 8 at index 2. The OverIndicatorRule should evaluate true when 10 > 5 (index 0), false when 10 > 15 (index 1), and true when 10 > 8 (index 2).

cases.expected: Rule instance of OverIndicatorRule where rule.isSatisfied(0) == false, rule.isSatisfied(1) == false, rule.isSatisfied(2) == true
cases.description: NumericIndicator wraps a ConstantIndicator(10). The other indicator returns decreasing values 20, 12, 9. The rule should be false for indices 0 and 1 (10 not greater than 20 or 12) and true for index 2 (10 > 9).

cases.expected: Rule instance of OverIndicatorRule where rule.isSatisfied(0) == false
cases.description: Both the NumericIndicator and the other indicator return the same value (10). OverIndicatorRule uses a strict 'greater than' comparison, therefore the rule must be unsatisfied at index 0.
Passing a null reference as the other indicator should result in a NullPointerException according to the contract of OverIndicatorRule.

cases.expected: Rule instance of OverIndicatorRule where rule.isSatisfied(0) == true
cases.description: NumericIndicator wraps ConstantIndicator(-5). Since -5 > -10, the rule must be satisfied at index 0.

cases.expected: Rule instance of OverIndicatorRule where rule.isSatisfied(0) == false
cases.description: NumericIndicator wraps ConstantIndicator(-5). Because -5 is not greater than -2, the rule must be unsatisfied at index 0.

cases.expected: Rule instance of OverIndicatorRule where rule.isSatisfied(0) == false, rule.isSatisfied(1) == true
cases.description: NumericIndicator is created via NumericIndicator.closePrice(series) where the series has close prices 100 (index 0) and 105 (index 1). Comparing against ConstantIndicator(102) should yield false at index 0 (100 > 102? false) and true at index 1 (105 > 102).
